verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack with a strong one-line headline and a prominent CTA. However, the LIMITED RUN and NEW pills butt into each other at top-left at mismatched sizes, NEW is oversized, the logo sits off-centre to the right, the glow circle is pulled away from the can, and 'Swipe up to shop' is enlarged and moved above the CTA. B tries a split layout, but the right column is crammed against the right edge, the logo is jammed next to the stacked, unequal badges, the can floats low-left with dead space around it, the bottom ~25% of the canvas is empty, and the swipe text is oversized and competes with the copy.
